theme: An open day, but the clock is Croatia.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday in St. Pete, Dan — nothing on the calendar. Today's work is decisions, not appointments: the Halloween call is due, and Croatia is three days out with a handful of bookings still to close before you lose signal at sea.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 5 call, meant to land before Croatia. The girls are in residence for it, and the Oct 18-Nov 1 St. Pete rental and car both cover Halloween, so a Maine answer unwinds three bookings while you are at sea.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: The 15-minute board sweep is tomorrow at 9. Arrive having settled the Halloween call and knowing which Croatia bookings are still hanging — those are the items to clear before the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Sept 19 Cavtat hotel still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The last night after the charter ends at noon at ACI Komolac. Cavtat puts the airport run at noon Saturday instead of 5 AM Sunday, and it has to be booked from dry land before you sail on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy ticket shows 0 checked bags, but two 55L duffels will not fly as carry-on. Verify the allowance on the Eurowings Discover record locator and buy bags online before airport-counter rates.

needsAttention.title: St. Pete lodging for Sept 20-21
needsAttention.detail: The two nights between your TPA landing and the Tuesday kid pickup are still open. Also worth a glance that the Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb converted from pending rather than expiring unaccepted.

inbox.noise: The rest is Airbnb host logistics for the St. Pete stay.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox needs a reply this morning.

resolved.title: UN PRI call deferred until you're back
resolved.detail: You asked to push the Conor Kehoe stewardship call past your trip; Kate confirmed and will revisit the diary when you return, so nothing is owed now.

recipe.title: Chestnut and Pancetta Salad
recipe.why: Autumn's first chestnuts and cured pork make a warm, earthy salad for cooling evenings.

tasks.title: Contact the Nautilus instructor — boarding time and return transfer
Book refundable backup car, Sept 20-Oct 5 (decision point Sept 7)
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — the St. Pete house is yours before the Croatia countdown takes over.
The Halloween decision is due today, and the Cavtat night and the bag question are the Croatia items that must close from dry land.
Tomorrow's 9 AM sweep with Mike is the moment to lock whatever is still open before the 8th.
